caption:
Your service area is one line in your footer.

"Northfield, Ashby, Millbrook and surrounding areas" tells a buyer in Millbrook almost nothing.

Give each town you really cover its own page:
→ The town in the headline ("Solar panels in Millbrook")
→ Installs you've done there, with your own photos
→ When you can next survey in that town
→ The local questions: permits, grid operator, which grants apply
→ Reviews from homes nearby

Only for towns you actually work in, with real details on each page. Copy-paste pages with the name swapped help nobody.

(Illustration of a generic site, not a real installer.)
